faithful_choreography.observation: The overall hands-on-hips dance sequence and chronological pose progression match closely, but several sampled frames show small differences in leg spread, foot angle, torso lean, and hip placement rather than being pixel/pose identical.
Jacket/arm silhouette changes slightly in some frames, especially the flared coat side and bent elbow shape, indicating minor pose/cloth-motion mismatch.

wardrobe.observation: Wardrobe is essentially the same: shiny dark jacket and pants, white shirt, dark tie/suspenders/belt/shoes. Minor differences appear in shirt wrinkle pattern and dark markings/tie-suspender alignment.
The jacket drape and trouser highlights are not identical frame-to-frame, though the costume category remains clearly matched.

background.observation: Both use a plain studio background, but B appears slightly green/gray tinted compared with A's cleaner white/light gray background.

camera_framing.observation: Framing is very close full-body contact-sheet framing, but subject scale and placement vary slightly across cells, with small differences in headroom/footroom and lateral position.

retro_low_budget_dance_video_look.observation: The simple full-body studio dance-video look is preserved, including flat backdrop and shiny 1980s-style wardrobe, but the background tint and slightly cleaner/generated facial detail make it not perfectly identical.

identity_face_hair.observation: B has noticeably different personalized face/hair, including curlier darker hair and facial-hair/stubble appearance, but this is treated as a minor allowed identity personalization difference.

uncertainty_due_to_sampled_frames: Medium-low. The 30 sampled frames at 1/6-second spacing show very close pose and costume fidelity, but unsampled motion between frames could contain additional timing or cloth-motion deviations not visible in the contact sheets.
